decisions.decision: Use Proxy-based req.url modification and request cloning in API route to avoid request body stream errors.
decisions.rationale: Cloning the request using standard new Request(url, req) for POST requests causes body stream ingestion failures in Next.js production builds.

decisions.decision: Intercept and strip directory deletions from the update API payload.
decisions.rationale: Keystatic attempts to flat-delete directories as files during updates, throwing an EISDIR exception in Node.js fs.rm.
